scope: independent saved JSON predictions, manifests, version and execution receipts; no EEG arrays/model tensors/forward/fitting

statistics_recalculated_independently.implementation: standalone NumPy/count arithmetic; did not import experiment statistics or fit code
statistics_recalculated_independently.exact_sign_flip: all512 sign assignments, observed magnitudes, two-sided abs(mean),1e-12 BA inclusion tolerance
statistics_recalculated_independently.secondary_holm: three fixed secondary contrasts, primary outside this family

material_findings: The primary full-CSP minus classifier-only contrast is +0.185185pp, CI crosses zero and exact p=.96875; it does not reproduce a general +5.47pp spatial-refit benefit.
The predeclared secondary EA-CSP minus full-CSP contrast is +5.648148pp [3.148148,8.703704], exact p=.00390625, three-secondary Holm=.01171875; all nine paired participant means positive.

Classifier-only minus frozen participant5 has raw floating difference5.551115123125783e-17 BA, mathematically equal query performance; use tolerance when describing ties, without rewriting frozen statistics.
limitations: Original EEG bytes and model tensors were not reopened by this independent JSON audit. Raw source length/SHA agreement here is agreement of recorded provenance with the frozen manifest, not a second full original-file read.

Model filter-array equality and internal EA reference fitting were checked by the executed runner and pre-execution tests; this JSON-only audit checks declared input roles and source-code identities, not a second model execution.
Dataset was previously used in paper1; new fixed experiment is independent-data acquisition replication, not an unseen or external-preregistered cohort.
V2 NumPy fixed-shrinkage implementation and96source labels differ from original Kumar MNE implementation and40source labels; dataset alone is not identified as cause of effect differences.
